prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1439; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with the rear-end collision in which they were injured. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already been in contact with our client, please let us know so we can address it.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured for this accident, along with a certified copy of the declarations page. Please also confirm whether any other policies, including umbrella or excess coverage, may apply.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes the claim file, photographs, vehicle data and event recorder information, repair estimates, adjuster notes, recorded statements, and any surveillance or dashcam footage. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal procedures that could affect these materials.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
